title: Pricing Note: Running Amount in Dispute on an Allowable Charge Review of a TRICARE Select Inpatient Claim (Appeals and Grievances)
content:
## Appeals and Grievances — running amount in dispute on an Allowable Charge Review as further paid TRICARE Select lines join

(1) The amount in dispute recorded for a further paid line joining an Allowable Charge Review is the amount the review carries once the line has joined it: the amount the review already carries plus the payment difference on the joining line, rounded to the cent.

(2) The review a line joins is the patient's Allowable Charge Review most recently filed among those still filed; the amount that review already carries is the largest amount in dispute recorded on its filed records on the claim — the Allowable Charge Review records on that claim number with status filed — since each joining record carries the running total; and the joining line is the claim's highest-numbered paid line, read from the TRICARE Select postings of the claim.

(3) The payment difference on the joining line is the TRICARE payment it would carry at the allowed amount claimed, less the TRICARE payment the line shows, never below zero and rounded to the cent.

(4) The allowed amount claimed on the joining line is its covered days at its paid daily rate — the covered days multiplied by that rate, rounded to the cent — the paid daily rate being its allowed amount divided by its covered days and rounded to the cent.

(5) The payment the joining line would carry at the allowed amount claimed is that allowed amount less the cost share figured on it, the cost share being the daily inpatient charge of the tier for each covered day, never less than the tier's minimum inpatient charge. The daily inpatient charge is the tier's network or non-network daily charge as the facility is recorded on the line; the tier is that of the TRICARE Select enrollment the line was billed under.

**Worked through (hypothetical).** The review's filed records on the claim carry 125.00 and, after an earlier join, 346.00; the review carries 346.00. The joining line (the highest-numbered paid line) has 4 covered days and an allowed amount of 3,400.00: paid daily rate 850.00, allowed amount claimed 3,400.00; cost share at 250.00 a day, 1,000.00; payment at the allowed amount claimed 2,400.00. The line shows a TRICARE payment of 2,275.00, so its payment difference is 125.00, and the amount recorded on the joining record is 346.00 plus 125.00, which is 471.00. Had the line shown 2,500.00, its difference would be 0.00 and the joining record would carry 346.00.
